name: Ilias: Legendy Al'kiona
source:
You live in a world where everything is decided by wealth and power, but the only thing that you're actually good at is . . . [b]cooking?[/b] A worthless skill, some may say. But why not use that talent to the fullest and see what happens? And romance as many cute girls as you want along the way. After all, the path to a strong woman's heart does run through her stomach.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/c/Alcyone_legends]Patreon[/url]]
